results.question: For each network, show its ID, name, number of subnets, and number of distinct IP versions used by those subnets, including networks with no subnets.

WITH subnet_stats AS (
    SELECT
        network_id,
        COUNT(*) AS subnet_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ip_version) AS distinct_ip_versions
    FROM subnets
    GROUP BY network_id
)
SELECT
    n.id AS network_id,
    n.name,
    COALESCE(ss.subnet_count, 0) AS subnet_count,
    COALESCE(ss.distinct_ip_versions, 0) AS distinct_ip_versions
FROM networks AS n

ORDER BY n.id;

The pred uses a CTE with pre-aggregation plus COALESCE(0) instead of direct LEFT JOIN aggregation, and adds ORDER BY n.id. The COALESCE(0) vs NULL for missing networks is functionally equivalent to COUNT returning 0. Output columns differ slightly in naming (network_id vs n.id, distinct_ip_versions vs ip_version_count) but the values are semantically the same. Row counts match at 49. results.question: For each network, show its name, standard attribute description, and number of tags, including networks without tags.
results.gold_sql: SELECT n.id, n.name, sa.description, COUNT(t.tag) AS tag_count FROM networks n JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = n.standard_attr_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.standard_attr_id = sa.id GROUP BY n.id, n.name, sa.description
